text: paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti . evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ ānanda kinti byākareyyāsīti . sace maṃ bhante evaṃ paccheyyuṃ katamesaṃ āvuso ānanda dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyittha vayo paññāyittha ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyittha . katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyissati vayo paññāyissati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyissati . #1 ma. ṭhitassa . sabbattha īdisameva . katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti . evaṃ puṭṭho
